comment: pager.c mhidden_description() names an M_AP_FURNITURE mimic from defsyms[mappearance].explanation. A Valkyrie level-teleports to the Rogue level in debug mode, stands north of the room's lower doorway and creates six small mimics with #wizgenesis; set_mimic_sym() makes the one in the doorway look like a wall (S_hwall), so makemon() prints "A wall appears next to you."
